one_line: Tell it your company: it finds your rivals, who is heading where you are heading, and who fell, from live hiring data.
service: The competitive-intelligence analyst: the person a company pays to name its rivals, report how they are doing, and warn who is coming.
approach: Pure-code analysis over Crustdata (company, people, job, web search). No model decides a number. Every claim shows its evidence and can be attacked by the Claim Court. A model, when a key is present, only words the findings and is checked against them.
next: Watchers for change alerts, sector mode, scoring our stored predictions after their due date, and a signed evidence ledger.
